dialing_mode.description: Allows you to dial outgoing calls using either the NANPA configuration or the E164 configuration. (Values: 0 = Use Main Account Setting, 1 = E164, 2 = NANPA)

ip_restriction.description: List of IP/Netmask to allow outgoing calls separated by commas

language.description: Language for system messages, such as "Invalid Option" (Values from getLanguages)

music_on_hold.description: Music on Hold Code (Values from getMusicOnHold)

pop_restriction.description: List of POP Servers to allow outgoing calls separated by commas

reseller_chargesetup.description: True if you want to charge Package Setup Fee after Save

rtp_hold_timeout.description: RTP Hold Time Out between 1 and 3600 (Example: 600)

tfcarrier.description: This allows you to select the carrier to be used for outgoing calls to toll-free numbers. (Values: -1 = Use main account settings, 0 = Default server setting, 1 = US carrier, 2 = Canadian carrier)

transcription_start_delay.description: Call Transcription Delay Seconds between 0 and 60, Increments of 5 (Example: 10 -> seconds)

setTimeCondition.description: - Updates a specific Time Condition if a time condition code is provided. - Adds a new Time Condition entry if no time condition code is provided.

routing_match.description: Routing for the Call when condition matches

routing_nomatch.description: Routing for the Call when condition does not matche

timecondition.description: ID for a specific Time Condition (Example: 1830 / Leave empty to create a new one)

weekdayend.description: All the Week Day End Conditions (Example: 'fri;sat')

weekdaystart.description: All the Week Day Start Conditions (Example: 'mon;sat')

setVoicemail.description: - Updates the information from a specific Voicemail.

attach_message.description: Yes for Attaching WAV files to Message (Values: 'yes'/'no')

email.description: Email address for receiving messages, multiple email addresses are allowed if separated by a comma

email_attachment_format.description: Code for Email Attachment format (Values from getVoicemailAttachmentFormats)

play_instructions.description: Code for Play Instructions Setting (Values from getPlayInstructions)

say_callerid.description: Yes for Saying the Caller ID (Values: 'yes'/'no')

timezone.description: Time Zone for Mailbox (Values from getTimeZones)

unavailable_message_recording.description: Recording for the Unavailable Message (values from getRecordings)

signupClient.description: - Signs a new Reseller Client to your Reseller Account.

unconnectDID.description: - Unconnects specific DID from Reseller Client Sub Account.

did.description: DID to be Unconnected from Reseller Sub Account(Example: 5551234567)

unconnectFAX.description: - Unconnects specific FAX DID from Reseller Client Sub Account.

did.description: FAX DID to be Unconnected from Reseller Sub Account (Example: 5551234567)
